and-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：两条跑道在绿地上交叉，航站楼与机坪位于交叉点附近。
and-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: two runways cross in green countryside, with the terminal and apron near the intersection.

and-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 蓝天下这座石墙小楼有绿色金属屋顶和木质门廊，门楣标着5805，门前旗杆上飘扬着美国国旗。
and-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Under a clear blue sky, a small stone-clad terminal with a green metal roof and timber entrance portico has an American flag flying by its doors.

and-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 航拍视角下，两条跑道在林地与农田之间交叉，跑道尽端散布着几栋白色建筑。
and-chatgpt-02.webp.en: From the air, two runways cross between woodland and farmland, with a few white buildings scattered near the ends of the strips.

and-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 路边一座石砌标牌用大号英文字母写着安德森地区机场的欢迎语，牌后停着一辆白色皮卡。
and-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A stone-based entrance sign spells out a welcome to Anderson Regional Airport in large white letters, with a pickup truck parked behind it.

and-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 越过铁丝网看去，跑道旁的黄色牌子标着17和35，尽头有座白色小塔，一架红色小飞机停在远处。
and-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Looking across a chain-link fence, a yellow sign beside the runway marks 17 and 35, with a small white tower and a red aircraft further along.

and-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 机场边的儿童游乐场：蓝色软垫上画着跑道标线，绿色遮阳棚下装有滑梯和攀爬架，铁丝网外就是停机坪。
and-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A playground beside the airfield paints runway markings on its blue surface, with slides and climbing frames under green shade canopies.
